coveragePersistenceRisks.finding: Cold services have new issued/qualified maps. Their first operation is persistent.read; pre-evaluating to populate maps would weaken the cold-reconstruction oracle. Persisted C08 references exclude transient portfolio-coverage-interval refs by an explicit assertion.

An exact 55000 known-components bound under omitted training remains conditioned. Complete C10 is produced only from current authenticated classifications; confirmed 40000 shifts the numerical bound to15000. A performance shortcut must not convert threshold precision into completeness or application.

The repeated reads bracket different awaited providers. Digest equality of one returned value does not authenticate future permission, rule, case or C10 observations. Removing an initial/final binding read or using a previously qualified preview changes the currently checked windows.

The existing map is a short-lived snapshot check for commit preflight, not numerical replay reuse. sfRunSourceFence explicitly excludes __sfProductV1, and provides no monotonic ABA generation for C08/case/rule/classification state. It cannot justify skipping a later mathematical/admission observation.

Issued interval proofs expire after300000ms and may be pruned on subsequent current checks. Very slow work can fail closed when its transient proof expires; no W18 expiration was observed by this reviewer. Increasing that lifetime or the test budget is not proposed.

Post-command qualification can change results for explicitly addressed absent cells. Historical C08/result proofs remain pinned to their producing composition; a W16 run or old financial proof must not be relabeled as W18 replay proof.

ownOptimizationCandidatesReviewed.reason: The callback returns only value/evidenceRefs, not an independently revalidatable producer proof over all canonical inputs. Adjacent witness validation alone does not establish that the final domain certificate/metadata is still available; it may also miss changed fixed behavior elsewhere in the interval. Keeping fresh authorization while dropping this final producer observation is not equivalent.

ownOptimizationCandidatesReviewed.candidate: Fuse coverage verify and qualify to skip the second preview
ownOptimizationCandidatesReviewed.reason: qualify is a public consumer of possibly forged incoming preview; it deliberately replays after its own current-authority read. verify produces one preview, then qualify observes authority and produces another. A private fusion would require a new proved contract/order for mutation between those callbacks, not a one-line removal. It saves only part of the complete-C10 path and does not help omitted training.
